subject: On-prem anchoring discount and SRE credit plan - Meridian Analytics
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lindsay Park <lindsay@meridiananalytics.com>
Cc: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 09:22:00 -0700
Subject: On-prem anchoring discount and SRE credit plan - Meridian Analytics

Hi Lindsay —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation I’m sending a concise proposal for the on-prem (VPC) commercial construct we discussed and two items we flagged as negotiation points: an anchoring/platform-fee discount for the initial two-year commit, and a short-term SRE credit to cover migration runbooks and early ops toil.

Attached: Redwood_VPC_Termsheet_v3.pdf (term highlights) and SRE_Credit_Workback.xlsx (workback and estimated hours). High level:
- Anchor offer: 18% off first 12 months of the platform fee if Meridian commits to a 24-month private deployment (onprem). Discount resets to 8% thereafter unless usage hits agreed burst thresholds.
- SRE credit: We can include a one-time operations credit equivalent to 120 SRE hours (applied as a credit against implementation invoice) to help with the initial rollout and runbook handoff.

Open items I’d like to surface so we can be efficient on the next call:
1) Is Meridian looking to amortize the platform fee (monthly) or capitalize it upfront? (affects invoice timing)
2) Do you need a separate on-call SLA add-on for 24/7 support during cutover? We can price a temporary 90-day elevated on-call at a fixed monthly rate or cover it under the SRE credit.
3) Any internal procurement timing constraints (PO, Q-triggers) we should know?

If that aligns, I’ll work with David to draft an amendment to the term sheet that captures the anchoring discount and the SRE credit mechanics. Can we schedule a 30-min alignment call Wednesday 10–10:30am PT?

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwoodinference.com
+1 415-555-0123

Attachments: Redwood_VPC_Termsheet_v3.pdf (27KB), SRE_Credit_Workback.xlsx (12KB)

From: David Kim <david_kim@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Mon, 3 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: On-prem anchoring discount and SRE credit plan - Meridian Analytics

Jasmine — quick notes from a pricing perspective before you send the term amendment:

1) Platform-fee anchoring: 18% for 12 months on a 24-month commit is within our current playbook, but procurement will push for a floor on consumption uplift. Add a clause: discount applies only if monthly average usage doesn’t exceed 150% of baseline for the first year; above that, discount ratchets to 10% for the months over threshold.

2) SRE credit handling: prefer to structure as an invoice credit with a 6-month expiration. Make clear credits are non-refundable and applied to migration/implementation line items only.

3) On-call SLA: recommend offering the 90-day elevated on-call as an opt-in paid addendum; if Meridian insists on inclusion, we should price it and reduce the anchor discount to ~14% to keep margin.

I’ll draft suggested language and push to legal for a narrow amendment (no cross-product changes). Also confirm whether this deal requires any import/export or data residency addendum; Meridian is in the US but has EU customers.

—David
David Kim
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
